resources.string: Return to the device and open Files to start a new session.
This session does not support file operations.
Sign in to SFTP through MeshCentral
Credentials are sent through MeshCentral for this session. The app does not request saving them. SSH host verification is managed by your MeshCentral server.
SFTP sign-in or connection failed. Reopen Files to try again; credentials are not retried automatically.
Reading the uploaded file back to verify its contents…
Upload verified: remote size and the SHA-256 of the downloaded contents match the sent file.

The SFTP transfer could not be verified. Its size, contents or server confirmation did not match, or the connection was interrupted. A partial or replaced file may remain. Inspect it before trying again.
Delete the empty folder “%1$s”? SFTP cannot recursively delete its contents here. If the folder is not empty, the operation will remain unconfirmed.
The file session has ended. No operation will be retried automatically.
No confirmation was received within 30 seconds. The session has ended; check the remote result before trying again.
The operation failed. The session has ended; check access and reopen Files.
The folder could not be read or its response exceeds a limit: 1 MiB or 20,000 entries. Check access or open a smaller folder. Any pending changes or transfers remain unconfirmed.
The requested result is visible in the refreshed folder.
The requested change could not be confirmed. Some changes may already have happened. Refresh and inspect the folder before trying again.
Transfer interrupted. A partial file may remain at the chosen destination; an existing uploaded file may have been replaced. Inspect it before retrying. No automatic retry or resume.
The download did not complete. The document selected in Android may be empty or partial; inspect or delete it.
The agent acknowledged closing the uploaded file.
Download complete. The selected document keeps its chosen name, including any .partial suffix. You can rename it in Android Files.
Choose a new document. A .partial suffix is suggested so interrupted downloads are identifiable. Even a completed download keeps the chosen name.
The listed destination must be unused. If another user creates that name before this request reaches the agent, it may be replaced.
Enter a name of up to 255 characters without slashes, a colon or control characters; “.” and “..” are not allowed.
This entry cannot be used safely in this app. Manage it in the MeshCentral web panel.
This name already exists. Choose a different name.
Permanently delete “%1$s”? This cannot be undone.
Permanently delete “%1$s” and everything inside it? A failure can leave only part of the folder deleted. This cannot be undone.

Confirm this destination and name. An existing file with this name will be replaced. If interrupted, it may be partial; cancelling an upload removes its destination file. The agent cannot atomically prevent replacement.
The operation will stop. A partial file or an unconfirmed change may remain. Nothing will be retried automatically.
